<robot name="cabinet_two_door">
  <!-- Units: metres, kilograms -->
  <!-- Origin: floor, under middle of object.
       X: across width (left/right), Y: toward back (front is -Y), Z: up -->
  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="35.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate rectangular slab: 1.10 x 0.59 x 0.10 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0900833333" iyy="0.6085333333" izz="0.5350833333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.59 0.10"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.05" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.59 0.10"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="back_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.295 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <!-- Thin plate: width 1.10 (X) x height 1.83 (Z) x thickness 0.02 (Y) -->
      <inertia ixx="3.3604333333" iyy="0.0668133333" izz="3.3604333333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.295 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.295 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.10 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="left_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <!-- Side: thickness 0.02 (X) x depth 0.59 (Y) x height 1.83 (Z) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.9640333333" iyy="3.5145333333" izz="3.5145333333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.59 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.59 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="right_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10.0"/>
      <!-- Side: thickness 0.02 (X) x depth 0.59 (Y) x height 1.83 (Z) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.9640333333" iyy="3.5145333333" izz="3.5145333333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.59 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.55 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.59 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door (hinged on vertical edge at X = 0, swinging outward to +X) -->
  <link name="left_door">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- Door: width 0.54 (X) x depth 0.02 (Y, hinge-to-front thickness) x height 1.83 (Z) -->
      <!-- approximate centered at door frame -->
      <inertia ixx="8.9821733333" iyy="0.4104666667" izz="7.3333333333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- Place door so its hinge edge is at X=0 and it extends to -X half width -->
      <origin xyz="-0.27 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.54 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.27 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.54 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right door (hinged on vertical edge at X = 0, swinging outward to -X) -->
  <link name="right_door">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- Same geometry as left door -->
      <inertia ixx="8.9821733333" iyy="0.4104666667" izz="7.3333333333"
               ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- hinge edge at X=0 and it extends to +X half width -->
      <origin xyz="0.27 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.54 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_black"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.27 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.54 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Kinematic structure -->
  <link name="cabinet_frame">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.01"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0001" iyy="0.0001" izz="0.0001" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.001 0.001 0.001"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="ghost"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.001 0.001 0.001"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="base_to_frame" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="base"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="back_to_frame" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="back_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="left_side_to_frame" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="left_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="right_side_to_frame" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="right_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Left door hinge at X=0, Z varies; hinge axis vertical along +Z.
       Door swings outward to +X: use joint rotation about Z with limits [-90,+90] but starting at 0 (closed).
       We'll define closed pose as door lying in plane Y ~ -0.285 with width extending to -X. -->
  <joint name="left_door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="left_door"/>
    <!-- Hinge line position: middle of cabinet width at X=0, near front face -Y, at half height -->
    <origin xyz="0 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <!-- axis along +Z -->
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.57079632679" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.05"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right door hinge at X=0, Z half height, swings outward to -X (opposite side).
       Closed pose door extends to +X. Same axis along +Z. -->
  <joint name="right_door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="right_door"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.285 0.915" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.57079632679" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.05"/>
  </joint>

  <material name="wood_black">
    <color rgba="0.25 0.20 0.15 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="ghost">
    <color rgba="0.8 0.8 0.8 0.0"/>
  </material>
</robot>
